title: The Points a Purchase Earns for a Circle Member
content:
## What the points are worked out from

Reward points earned on a purchase by a Northbeam Circle Membership are worked out from what the profile's
orders are billed at, the work carried out alongside them and the goods that have gone back, and the whole of
that spend is taken at one rate.

## Settling the spend

The spend the points are earned on is the merchandise lines billed to the profile in the twelve months ending
on the handling day.

Discounts credited on the profile's orders are taken off the lines counted before any rate is applied. The
spend is the lines counted as they stand.

Goods that have gone back are taken off the same spend, so that points are not earned on merchandise the
profile no longer has. Nothing is taken off the spend for goods going back.

Chargeable work carried out on the TechWorks agreement the profile holds is brought into the same spend.
Nothing is brought into the spend for work.

The spend the rate is applied to never falls below nothing: where the goods that have gone back come to more
than the lines counted and the work brought into the spend together, the spend is nothing and no points are
earned on it.

## Building the rate

The rate is the base rate of the tier recorded on the membership, and the department bonus and the volume
uplift are added on top of it; the rate so built applies to the whole of the spend rather than to a part of
it. There is no department bonus. There is no volume uplift.

## The order and the rounding

The order is fixed: the spend is settled first, then the rate is built and applied once to the whole of it,
and only that figure is rounded, to the nearest whole point, with a half point rounded to the nearest even
point.

## The yearly ceiling

Once the points earned in the twelve months ending on the handling day reach the yearly points cap of the
tier, no further points are earned, and what is booked never takes the membership past that cap.

## The figure worked through on hypothetical inputs

Take a membership on Circle Plus Annual, whose base rate is 1 point per USD and whose yearly points ceiling
is 60000. Take merchandise lines of 1000.50 billed to the profile in the twelve months ending on the handling
day, and take for this illustration no discount credited, nothing taken off for goods going back and nothing
brought into the spend for work: the spend is 1000.50. With no department bonus and no volume uplift the rate
stands at 1 point per USD, and the whole spend at that rate comes to 1000.5 points, which rounds to 1000
points, a half point going to the nearest even point. Lines of 1001.50 on the same tier come to 1001.5
points, which rounds to 1002 points on the same rule.

Where the points earned in the twelve months ending on the handling day already stand at 59300 against that
tier's ceiling of 60000, what is booked is held to 700 points.
